result:
Eighteen of the 19 checks are green on HEAD, and I explained the 19th (v28.20). I didn't re-run them this time. The count comes from the earlier run's notes in `tools/handoff/console/notes/53-corpus-reds-b.md`, which has one line per check. I didn't touch any of o-02's 22.

- **Stale checks (17):** a later ship changed each one on purpose, and I retargeted each to keep its intent under the new rule. These are v26.54, 26.59, 26.97, 27.00, 27.56, 27.75, 27.79, 27.80, 27.83, 27.91, 28.06, 29.11, 29.14, 29.30, 29.31, 29.32 and 29.39.
- **v29.33 (title and mode menu on the shared look):** this was a real fault. The title and mode rules had six raw pixel sizes. I fixed them in the game as spacing tokens in v32.87, with no change on screen. I also limited the check to the title and mode rules, because later screens (stash, pause, Settings) have added 58 other raw-pixel rules to the shared block.
- **v28.20 (kit tile names fit at the default menu size):** this one is still red. At menu zoom 1.3 the 15 gun-key and item-wheel names are cut off. The names are 20px, but the tile leaves only 35px (guns) or 33px (wheel) for names that need up to 69px. The fix is a stash layout choice, either two columns of tiles or 16px names with the picture hidden on narrow tiles. Either one affects pad navigation of the tiles, so I didn't do it blind. I logged it in `alarms.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: v28.20 stays red until the stash layout call is made.
